source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 10 (may increase/decrease at selection) · Posts: 3 designation(s) · Type: Central University · Training engagement (initially 1 year, extendable to max 2 years) · Mode: Online · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: By 6 December 2026 · Stipend: ₹20,000 (first year) / ₹22,000 (second year if extended) · Selection: Screening / Shortlisting + Interview · Location: Fursatganj, Amethi
Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), a Central University established under the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) Act, 2013, invites applications from Indian Nationals for engagement as Professional Trainees. The university released the RGNAU Professional Trainee Notice 2026 (PDF) on 23 October 2026 for 10 positions across Management, Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering and Pharmacy.
RGNAU Professional Trainee Bharti 2026 covers 10 posts at Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, or any other location the University requires. The headquarters is at Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The University focuses on higher learning and critical research to support the aviation industry in India.
Candidates who hold the matching qualification for their field should apply online at the RGNAU Samarth portal by 6 December 2026. Retain a hard copy of the form and supporting documents for the interview if shortlisted.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Incomplete applications are rejected outright; retain a hard copy with all certificates for the interview if shortlisted.
Suppression of facts, fake documents or false information leads to termination of training.
Degrees from institutions declared fake or derecognised by UGC make a candidate ineligible.
Trainees have no right to claim absorption, regularisation or seniority in the University.

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Master’s Degree in Business Management or Administration or relevant Management discipline + strong MS Office knowledge → Professional Trainee (Management) – 8 posts
Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC → Professional Trainee (Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering) – 1 post
D.Pharm or B.Pharm from a PCI-recognised institute + valid registration as a Pharmacist with Central or State Pharmacy Council → Professional Trainee (Pharmacy) – 1 post
Hard disqualifier: Not a citizen of India, or convicted by a court, or criminal proceedings pending, or degrees from UGC-declared fake institutions.
*Number of positions may increase or decrease at the time of selection.

What Posts Are Available? – RGNAU Professional Trainee Vacancy 2026
Management holds 8 of the 10 positions. Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering and Pharmacy are single seats. The University may increase or decrease the number of positions at the time of selection.
*Number of positions may increase/decrease at the time of selection.

Who Is Eligible for RGNAU Professional Trainee 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile condition.
Professional Trainee (Management): Master’s Degree in Business Management or Administration or in a relevant management-related discipline from a recognised University or Institution. Strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and presentation tools.
Desirable: Certifications in Public Policy, Governance, Project Management, or Strategic Management; academic exposure to policy analysis and organisational management; proficiency in research methodology, report writing and policy drafting; ability to prepare policy notes, briefing papers, presentations and analytical reports for senior Government officials.
Professional Trainee (Electrical Engineering): Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.
Desirable: Electrical Estimation & Costing skills (detailed estimates, BOQ, rate analysis, quantity take-off, material costing, cable sizing based on CPWD/DSR rates); training in estimation, costing and tender documentation.
Professional Trainee (Civil Engineering): Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.
Desirable: Postgraduate Diploma/Certificate course in Construction Management, Project Management or Quality Control; certification in AutoCAD, STAAD, Primavera, MS Project or other relevant civil engineering software; training in estimation, costing and tender documentation.
Professional Trainee (Pharmacy): Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) or Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from an institute recognised by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Mandatory Registration: Valid registration as a Pharmacist with the Central or State Pharmacy Council.
Desirable: Working knowledge of MS Office and digital inventory logging and fundamental emergency first-aid awareness.
Qualification must be held by: Not stated in the notice.

✅ A 29-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1997 — eligible (as on 6 December 2026).
❌ A 31-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1995 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).

RGNAU Professional Trainee भर्ती 2026 – 10 पद
राजिव गांधी नेशनल एविएशन यूनिवर्सिटी (RGNAU), अमेठी ने मैनेजमेंट, इलेक्ट्रिकल/सिविल इंजीनियरिंग और फार्मेसी में 10 प्रोफेशनल ट्रेनी पदों के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन आमंत्रित किए हैं। अंतिम तिथि 6 दिसंबर 2026 है। यह प्रशिक्षण अवधि है, स्थायी नौकरी नहीं।
अंतिम तिथि कब है? ऑनलाइन आवेदन 6 दिसंबर 2026 तक जमा करना है। उम्र और योग्यता इसी तारीख तक गिनी जाएगी।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? भारतीय नागरिक जिनकी उम्र 30 साल से ज्यादा न हो। मैनेजमेंट के लिए मास्टर्स डिग्री, इंजीनियरिंग के लिए डिग्री/डिप्लोमा, फार्मेसी के लिए डी.फार्म/बी.फार्म और फार्मासिस्ट रजिस्ट्रेशन जरूरी है।
आवेदन कैसे करें? https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/ पर ऑनलाइन फॉर्म भरें। शॉर्टलिस्ट होने पर इंटरव्यू के लिए हार्ड कॉपी और सर्टिफिकेट साथ रखें।
वेतन और चयन कैसे होगा? पहले साल ₹20,000 और अगर बढ़ाया तो दूसरे साल ₹22,000 प्रति माह स्टाइपेंड। चयन स्क्रीनिंग और इंटरव्यू से होगा। स्थायी नौकरी का दावा नहीं।

No TA/DA is paid for attending the test/interview.
No interview stage marks or ratio are printed. No written-exam pattern is specified in the notice.

The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
This is a short-term training engagement of up to 2 years at a Central University, with a fixed stipend of ₹20,000 in the first year. Of the 10 positions, 8 are in Management, so most applicants compete in that field. The Engineering and Pharmacy seats are single positions that may change in number at selection. There is no right to absorption or regularisation, and the engagement can be short-closed for indiscipline without prior notice.
Best fit: Recent Master’s holders in Management who want structured exposure at an aviation-focused university, or diploma/degree holders in Electrical or Civil Engineering and registered pharmacists looking for a one-to-two-year training stint.
Skip if you need a permanent post or a higher starting stipend; the notice prints no path to regularisation.
Practical tip: Keep a complete hard-copy set of the form and all certificates ready, because incomplete applications are rejected and originals are checked at the interview.
Retain a hard copy of the Application Form along with all copies of certificates / educational qualification/experience/testimonials and other requisite documents in support of eligibility (to be submitted at the time of interview if shortlisted). Original certificates relating to age, qualifications, experience, etc. at the time of appearing in the test/interview.
